description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for filtering, sorting, and formatting references (refs) in a version control system, likely Git. It includes definitions for ref filtering options, ref sorting, ref formatting, and related operations.

methods.name: ref_kind_from_refname
methods.description: Returns the reference kind based on the provided reference name.

methods.name: filter_refs
methods.description: Filters a set of references based on the given ref_filter and type, storing results in ref_array.

methods.name: filter_and_format_refs
methods.description: Filters refs, sorts, formats, and prints them according to specified options.

methods.name: ref_array_clear
methods.description: Clears all memory allocated to a ref_array.

methods.name: verify_ref_format
methods.description: Verifies if the given ref_format is correct and parses used atoms.

methods.name: ref_array_sort
methods.description: Sorts the ref_array according to the provided ref_sorting.

methods.name: ref_sorting_set_sort_flags_all
methods.description: Sets sort flags for all elements of a ref_sorting list.

methods.name: format_ref_array_item
methods.description: Formats a ref_array_item into a string buffer based on the ref_format.

methods.name: ref_sorting_release
methods.description: Releases memory associated with a ref_sorting object.

methods.name: ref_sorting_options
methods.description: Converts a list of sort options into a ref_sorting structure.

methods.name: setup_ref_filter_porcelain_msg
methods.description: Sets up translated strings for ref filter output.

methods.name: print_formatted_ref_array
methods.description: Prints up to maxcount refs from ref_array using specified format.

methods.name: pretty_print_ref
methods.description: Prints a single ref outside of filtering, given its name and object IDs.

methods.name: ref_array_push
methods.description: Pushes a new ref onto a ref_array.

methods.name: filter_ahead_behind
methods.description: Computes ahead-behind counts for refs if format includes such atoms.

methods.name: filter_is_base
methods.description: Computes base checks for refs if format includes is-base atoms.

methods.name: ref_filter_clear
methods.description: Clears memory in a ref_filter structure.
